title: Preserve pin-specific FetchContent roots across reconfigure
body: Configuring RmlUi with FETCHCONTENT_SOURCE_DIR_RMLUI pointing to the 6.3 clone while FETCHCONTENT_BASE_DIR still referenced the shared 6.0 cache caused duplicate definitions: source headers came from 6.3 but the reused precompiled header came from 6.0. The successful fresh configure explicitly set VIXEN_FETCHCONTENT_CACHE to build/fetchcontent-witness and cleared FETCHCONTENT_SOURCE_DIR_RMLUI. A later cmake --build reran CMake after the CMakeLists timestamp changed and the process environment override was lost, restoring the shared cache. Persist the isolated root and keep each FetchContent source and binary tree paired.

title: Make CodegenTool bootstrap independent of host ICU configuration
body: A clean full CMake build stopped in engine_codegen_tool before generators because dotnet build CodegenTool.csproj exited with Couldn't find a valid ICU package installed. Setting DOTNET_SYSTEM_GLOBALIZATION_INVARIANT=1 around the full cmake --build let CodegenTool compile. Have CMake provision or check ICU, or provide a supported invariant mode for this utility, so builds do not need an ad hoc host environment override.

title: Keep Dozen local libraries in the documented GPU test environment
body: The login-shell export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/usr/lib/wsl/lib cleared the inherited /home/liory/.local/lib path containing libxcb-keysyms.so.1. All 20 GPU cases then failed at vkCreateInstance with VK_ERROR_INCOMPATIBLE_DRIVER. Exporting LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/usr/lib/wsl/lib:/home/liory/.local/lib made all 62 focused tests pass. Document a test launcher that prepends WSL runtime libraries without dropping host-local ICD dependencies.
